case_name: Vinay Bareja & Ors vs The State Nct Of Delhi & Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: The State Nct Of Delhi & Anr (wife, husband, etc.)

facts_of_case: Petitioners and respondent no.2 have resolved their disputes and differences vide Memorandum of Understanding dated 07.01.2022. Petitioner no.1 shall pay a total amount of Rs.25 lacs in full and final settlement of all the claims of respondent no.2 arising out of their marriage.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement agreement can dissolve a marriage.
legal_principles.held: It has been agreed that the petitioner no. 1 shall pay a total amount of Rs.25 lacs in full and final settlement of all the claims of the respondent no. 2 arising out of their marriage besides return of dowry articles including jewellery.

legal_principles.principle: A party can withdraw their petition if the dispute is resolved.
legal_principles.held: Respondent no. 2 admits that she has already received the total amount of Rs.25 lacs.
use_in: cases involving dispute resolution and petition withdrawal

outcome.final_order: Quashing of FIR No. 932/2021, dated 03.11.2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 Indian Penal Code, 1860, PS Binda Pur.
